title: BUG: 312 / 312.2.c-d / 337.4 / 338.1 — engine lets the NON-priority player play a Reaction while the item's controller still holds Priority

repro.testName: BUG: 312 / 312.2.c-d / 337.4 / 338.1 — engine lets the NON-priority player play a Reaction while the item's controller still holds Priority

history.note: Chain-priority gate in play-spell is rules-correct (312/337.4) but breaks ~12 existing card tests (Wind Wall, Riposte, Abandon, Brynhir, Ravenborn Tome...) that cast a Reaction from the non-priority seat without passing priority; needs a coordinated harness change (auto-pass priority in cast) — reverted
